_doc: The first run of 28 Nov 2026: a trial owner's 'Call people' brief (brief.txt, verbatim). What a reader expects it to yield is written here by hand: six tasks, one stated fact, the rules and calling window the owner gives in answer. The answers are recorded, not the owner's own: the run's real answers were not kept.

tasks.text: install it on their phone's home screen
log in with their mobile number
set the app language to Telugu
add their farm in My Farms

facts: We are Rytu Khata, an app that helps farmers keep their farm expenses, crop sales and profit on their phone.

script_case.title: First run: Rytu Khata app set-up

script_case.goal: The app is on their home screen and they have entered a first expense and sale.
